title: Glyph strip stitching
summary: convert-apply and convert-validate --glyph-stitch slices and stitches a TBitmap glyph strip per a book G[I/N] expressions; info capability glyph_stitch
intro: Convert a form whose images are glyph strips: add --glyph-stitch and the G[I/N] links of the book are realised on the .dfm surface instead of refused.

questions.ask: Convert a form whose images are glyph strips
Does the book have a glyph link the engine cannot read the slot count of?
